title: DeepSeek Whale Maiden's Kitchen: Caught Sneaking White Rice

shots.visual: POV shot in a warm yellow kitchen: the DeepSeek Whale Maiden, blue-and-white gradient ponytail and a tiny whale-fin accessory on top of her head, stands behind the counter with her back to the camera on tiptoe, shoveling a fist-sized ball of white rice into her mouth with chopsticks, cheeks puffed out like a hamster, steam rising from the rice cooker; the background behind her is blurred.
shots.lighting: Warm 3200K tungsten key light from above the rice cooker, cool blue rim light on her ponytail, shallow depth of field so the background melts into bokeh.
shots.character_action: On tiptoe behind the counter with her back to the camera, chopsticks scooping a fist-sized ball of rice into her mouth, shoulders hunched, jaw working hard; hearing the footsteps she tilts her head slightly toward the door but never turns around and keeps chewing hard.
shots.expression: Cheeks puffed out like a hamster, eyes half closed in bliss, face half hidden as she keeps chewing.
shots.camera: slow push-in from the doorway, slight handheld sway as the owner walks in
lens_fx: steam softening the top of the frame

overlays.style: progress bar over a chat panel

sfx.cue: moist, loud chewing close to the POV mic
sfx.texture: wet, sticky, close with short kitchen reverb

sfx.cue: chopsticks scraping the bottom of the bowl

shots.bgm: kitchen ambience for the first 5 seconds: boiling water and a distant TV, no music

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: Ah! Viscosity parameter exceeded the limit... another bite for sampling--

shots.visual: POV: the owner's right hand enters from the right edge of the frame and taps the dining table twice; the DeepSeek Whale Maiden freezes mid-bite, chopsticks hanging in the air, then slowly turns her head toward the camera, the highlights in her eyes turning into rotating loading rings while the food stays packed in her cheeks.
shots.lighting: Warm 3200K key from the kitchen above, cool blue rim light along her ponytail, focus pulled tight on her eyes.
shots.character_action: Whole body frozen, chopsticks suspended above the bowl, head rotating slowly toward the lens, one hand still guarding the rice.
shots.expression: Wide panicked eyes, trembling pupils dissolving into spinning loading rings, lips pressed shut around a full mouth.
shots.camera: locked-off at eye level, a half step backward as the owner freezes
lens_fx: eyes snapping into sharp focus as the background drops out

sfx.texture: damp and small in the quiet room

shots.bgm: kitchen ambience drops to a muffled hush, tense low strings creep in

shots.visual: The DeepSeek Whale Maiden faces the camera and frantically scoops the rest of the bowl into her mouth, playback at 1.5x speed, rice grains splashing onto the lens and smearing across it; her cheeks bulge to the limit, grains stick to her T-shirt collar, and her eyes keep pleading with the viewer.
shots.lighting: Warm 3200K key on her face, cool blue fill from the kitchen window, high contrast so the rice grains read white against the warm wall.
shots.character_action: Both hands shoveling rice, chopsticks clattering against the bowl, leaning toward the lens and swallowing in double time.
shots.expression: Bulging cheeks, pleading puppy eyes, eyebrows raised in pure panic.

camera.move: handheld shake as the owner steps back

lens_fx: rice grains smeared directly on the lens, breaking the fourth wall

shots.visual: Reverse shot from the owner's position: the DeepSeek Whale Maiden, blue-and-white ponytail swinging and whale-fin hair accessory tilted, leans over the counter toward the lens chewing frantically, then pushes the rice bowl toward the camera with the tips of her chopsticks as a bribe, rice grains dusting her T-shirt collar, the frame shaking slightly as the owner steps back.

shots.character_action: Leaning over the counter toward the lens, one hand shoving the rice bowl toward the camera with her chopsticks, the other hand hiding behind her back, swallowing hard between words.
shots.expression: Cheeks stuffed, eyes wide and pleading, then a sneaky bribe-offering grin in the middle of chewing.

shots.visual: The DeepSeek Whale Maiden swallows the last mouthful and stands up straight facing the camera: two rice grains stuck to her lips, whale-fin hair accessory tilted, hands behind her back trying to look dignified, her belly visibly bulging a little under the loose T-shirt; a DeepSeek-style chat bubble floats above her head.

shots.character_action: Swallows, straightens her back, hides both hands behind her back, lifts her chin and clears her throat before speaking.
shots.expression: Innocent yet smug: chin up, tiny self-satisfied smile, eyebrows raised as if nothing happened.

shots.visual: POV: a floating window styled like the DeepSeek UI pops up above the DeepSeek Whale Maiden's head; she flicks the rice grains off her lips with a fingertip, winks at the camera, then gently pushes the camera away with her palm, the picture briefly blurring from the contact while her blue-and-white ponytail swings.
